## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the closing time of a [`gmeow:OpeningHoursSpecification`](../classes/gmeow-OpeningHoursSpecification.md) window as an [xsd:time.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#time.)

### Avoid when

- Avoid carrying the opening time here (that is [`gmeow:opensAt`](gmeow-opensAt.md)) and avoid more than one close time per window — it is functional; mint a separate window for a split schedule.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:closesAt`](gmeow-closesAt.md) once per [`gmeow:OpeningHoursSpecification`](../classes/gmeow-OpeningHoursSpecification.md) (functional) to an [xsd:time](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#time), paired with [`gmeow:opensAt`](gmeow-opensAt.md) and [`gmeow:openingDay`](gmeow-openingDay.md); projects to [schema:closes.](https://schema.org/closes.)

### Examples

- ex:weekdayHours [`gmeow:closesAt`](gmeow-closesAt.md) "17:00:00"^^[xsd:time.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#time.)
